verdict.rationale: Reflect does expose a public API with OAuth2/PKCE, but per its own docs the API only supports appending data to notes and returning bookmarked links ('a few other things'), while the UI offers AI chat/search, publishing, integrations, imports, Kindle sync, audio transcription, etc. that are not documented as API-accessible. No OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found, reinforcing that API coverage is narrow. missing for 10: API endpoints for AI features, semantic search, publishing, integrations, imports/exports, and any independent confirmation of broader API parity.
